0022600003.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons as the Spurs host the Thunder, and San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance, who is out after knee surgery, while Tobias Harris is day-to-day with a calf strain and a game-time decision. Oklahoma City is missing Otega Oweh, who is out following Achilles surgery. The Spurs won the 2025-26 season series 4-1 and the 2025-26 playoff series 4-3, including a 111-103 playoff win in Oklahoma City on May 30, 2026. ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Spurs a 55% chance to win.
